Okay, imagine you want to be the boss of a big playground. There are lots of kids who want to be the boss, and they all say they know the best games and rules. Some grown-ups think we should give everyone a quiz to see who knows the most about being a good boss.

But here’s why we don’t: Being a good boss of a big country is really, really hard. There are so many things to know—like money, people from all over, and big problems. A quiz can’t really tell if someone will be a good boss, because being a good boss isn’t just about knowing facts. It’s also about how you help people, make good choices, and listen.

So, instead of a quiz, people talk to each other, watch what the boss does, and vote for who they think will do a good job. It’s not perfect, but that’s how it works right now.
